description: Defines a struct 'RialtoGStreamerMSEBaseSinkCallbacks' containing callback function objects for various media sink events in a GStreamer-based media streaming context.

classes.name: RialtoGStreamerMSEBaseSinkCallbacks
classes.description: A struct encapsulating callback functions for media sink events such as error, load completion, seek completion, end of stream, state change, buffering, and QoS updates.

methods.name: errorCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked with an error message string.

methods.name: loadCompletedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when loading is completed.

methods.name: seekCompletedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when seeking is completed.

methods.name: stateChangedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when playback state changes, with the new state as parameter.

methods.name: qosCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked with processed and dropped data metrics.
